RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November  30, 2005/Agrahayana 9, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional
Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 20
Implementation of power projects
*101. SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of  POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether of the 44 power projects
under implementation currently, 39
projects are slated to come up by the first
year of the Eleventh Five Year Plan period;
(b) if so, whether 5 projects are reported
to be facing constraints in timely
commissioning;
(c) the total projects that are being
completed within the stipulated period of
time and how many will be there which
will not be completed;
(d) whether any guidelines had been
issued by the Ministry of Statistics and
Programme Implementation to the
Ministry of Power in this regard; and
(e) if so, what steps are being taken by
the Ministry of Power to implement
suggestions made by the Ministry of
Statistics and Programme Implementation?
Non-utilisation of funds under SGSY
*102. DR. KARAN SINGH:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have failed to
spend funds allocated to Sampoorna
Gramin Swarozgar Yojana (SGSY);
(b) if so, whether Centre allocated
Rs. 1000 crore for the programme upto
June this year which was twice the sum
allocated  last year, but only Rs. 469.56
crore of this was released and even paltry
Rs. 61.94 crore was used;
(c) what are the main reasons for failure
in utilisation of funds under SGSY and the
agencies responsible for this;
(d) what action has been taken against
the said agencies; and
(e) what are the steps taken to fully
utilize the funds allocated for SGSY during
the remaining period of 2005-06?

32
Funds released under RGNDWM to
Andhra Pradesh
*103. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of RURAL DEVELOP-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the funds released to
the State of Andhra Pradesh under Rajeev
Gandhi National Drinking Water Mission
during the last one year till date;
(b) whether grants are being given to
voluntary organizations under the scheme;
(c) if so, the funds provided thereunder
during the last one and half year in the State
of Andhra Pradesh; and
(d) the district-wise details of projects
undertaken under the Mission in the State
of Andhra Pradesh during the last one and
half year till date?
Indian Approach Paper at WTO
*104. SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA: Will
the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that WTO has
formally accepted the "Approach Paper"
of Government of India outlining the
structure and basis for services
negotiations;
(b) if so, whether Government is
lobbying for acceptance of the contents of
this Paper by majority of WTO members;
and
(c) by when an intensive package
allowing developing countries to have
flexibility on opening of services based on
the development levels will be cleared by
the WTO?
Signature campaign against power
hike in the Capital
*105. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that signature
campaign against power hike in the Capital
has taken place demanding withdrawal of
recent increase in power tariff;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto and whether any direction for
reconsideration of hike was given to the
State Government; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Communal riots in different parts of
the country
†*106. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that occurence of
communal riots in different parts of the
country have come to light during the last
six months;
(b) if so, the names of the places where
such riots have taken place;
(c) whether any enquiry is being
conducted to find out the culprits of these
riots;
(d) if so, persons given responsibility
of enquiry in each case; and
(e) the details of those persons who are
enquiring into these incidents what are
themselves coming under the purview of
Government enquiry?

Import-export gap
†*107. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that imports in
the country are increasing more than
exports;
(b) if so, the value of imports and
exports done in the country during first six
months of the year 2005-06; and
(c) the value of crude oil imported in
the country and whether it is a fact that the
foreign trade of the country is running in
losses due to gap between import and
export?

Organisation

BHATTACHARJEE: Will the Minister of

RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday,  the November  30, 2005/Agrahayana 9, 1927 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Commerce and Industry; Defence; Home Affairs; Non-
Conventional Energy Sources; Power; Rural Development; Textiles)
Total number of questions — 155
Zones set up for promotion of
exports
†735. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have set up Special Economic Zone, Export
Processing Zone, etc to increase exports in
the country;
(b) if so, the number of zones set
up with different names in the country so
far;
(c) the average number of units in these
zones;
(d) whether these units have made
exports during 2004-05 and from April to
September in 2005-06; and
(e) if so, the value of this export and its
percentage to the total exports made by
the country during this period?
Trade Agreements signed by India
736. SHRI  PYARELAL  KHANDELWAL:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) how many Free Trade Agreements,
Preferential Trading Arrangements and
Regional Trading Arrangements have been
signed by India so far;
(b) how many such Agreements/
Arrangements are under the consideration
of Government; and
(c) what economic benefit India would
derive from each one of these Agreements/
Arrangements?
Trade between India and Pakistan
737. SHRI MOOLCHAND
MEENA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
REDDY:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether India and Pakistan have
pledged to sort out outstanding trade related
issues;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

168
(b) whether Commerce Ministers of
India and Pakistan met recently and had
discussion as to how trade between two
countries could be improved;
(c) what were main points discussed
between the Ministers;
(d) whether any agreement between
India and Pakistan has been reached;
(e) whether both countries have agreed
to take up issues jointly at WTO; and
(f) if so, what is the trade level between
India and Pakistan at present and to what
extent it will be further improved?
Export promotion schemes
†738. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are launching many export promotion
schemes for increasing exports from the
country;
(b) if so, the names of these schemes;
(c) the amount of financial assistance
proposed to be provided under each
scheme; and
(d) the total amount of financial
assistance provided to the trade institutions
under these schemes during 2004-2005?
Export of agricultural products
†739. SHRI SURENDRA LATH:
SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have launched
any special scheme to increase the export
of agricultural products;
(b) if so, the details of the products
included therein and the incentives given to
exporters;
(c) the value of agricultural products
exported during the last three years till date
and increase in the exports likely to be
achieved through the new scheme;
(d) whether export of agricultural
products has declined continuously during
the last three years; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor alongwith
the details thereof?
Perfume manufacturing units
740. MAULANA OBAIDULLAH
KHAN AZMI:
SHRI MOTIUR RAHMAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the details of perfume manufacturing
units in the country;
(b) the problems being faced by such
units; and
(c) the steps being taken by
Government to solve those problems?
Trade with US
741. SHRI DARA SINGH:
SHRI S. ANBALAGAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that our current
level of trade with the United States stand
at $21 billion which is far below potential;
(b) whether any fruitful talks in this
regard were held recently with the visiting
US trade representative Rob Portman
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

169
particularly with regard to removal of non-
tariff barriers on Indian products by the
US; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and by when
reported target of $40 billion is likely to be
achieved?
Rice export
742. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of rice exported during
the last three years, with Basmati and non-
Basmati rice separately;
(b) the steps taken to improve export
of rice, non-Basmati rice in particular; and
(c) the target fixed for export of rice
during the Tenth Plan period and the steps
taken to achieve that?
SEZ in Karnataka
